blocks.text: Yeh page portal ki taraf se Unit 1 (Complex Numbers) ka revision summary hai. Yeh textbook ka page nahin hai: is mein poori unit ki definitions, formulas, rules, aam ghaltiyan aur sawalon ki qismen ek jagah jama ki gayi hain. Poori wazahat, solved examples aur exercises ke hal ke liye is unit ke topic aur exercise pages par wapas jayein.
Important definitions (aham ta'reefein)
Bachon, revision ka pehla qadam yeh hai ke har lafz ka matlab saaf ho. Neeche har term ek line mein hai; agar koi line samajh na aaye to us topic ka page dobara dekh lein.

items: Imaginary unit (iota): \(i = \sqrt{-1}\), is liye \(i^{2} = -1\). Yaad rakhein: \(i\) khud \(-1\) nahin, us ka square \(-1\) hai.
Complex number: \(z = a + ib\), jahan \(a, b \in \mathbb{R}\) (dono real). Tamam complex numbers ka set \(C\) hai.
Real part aur imaginary part: \(\operatorname{Re}(z) = a\), \(\operatorname{Im}(z) = b\). Dono real numbers hain (\(\operatorname{Im}(3+4i) = 4\) hai, \(4i\) nahin).
Har real number \(a = a + 0i\) bhi complex number hai. \(ib\) (jab \(b \ne 0\)) purely imaginary number kehlata hai.
Conjugate (jora, ulta sign wala saathi): \(\overline{z} = a - ib\); sirf imaginary part ka sign badalta hai. Real number apna conjugate khud hai (self-conjugate).
Ordered pair form: \((a, b)\) ka matlab \(a + ib\).
Argand diagram: aisa plane jis ka \(x\)-axis real axis aur \(y\)-axis imaginary axis hai; \(z = x + iy\) point \((x, y)\) hai.
Modulus: \(|z| = \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\), yani origin se \(z\) ka faasla; yeh kabhi negative nahin hota.
\(z\) ka square root: aisa number \(w\) jis ka \(w^{2} = z\). Har non-zero \(z\) ke theek do square roots hain: \(w\) aur \(-w\).

Complex polynomial: \(P(z) = a_{n}z^{n} + \dots + a_{1}z + a_{0}\), coefficients complex aur \(a_{n} \ne 0\); \(n\) degree hai aur \(a_{n}\) leading coefficient (sab se bari power ka coefficient). Jin \(z\) par \(P(z) = 0\) ho, woh \(P\) ke zeros aur \(P(z) = 0\) ke roots hain.
Cube roots of unity: \(x^{3} = 1\) ke roots, yani \(1, \omega, \omega^{2}\). Fourth roots of unity: \(x^{4} = 1\) ke roots, yani \(1, -1, i, -i\).
Polar coordinates \((r, \theta)\): pole \(O\) se directed faasla \(r\), aur polar axis se anti-clockwise naapa gaya angle \(\theta\).

Polar form: \(z = r(\cos\theta + i\sin\theta) = r\operatorname{cis}\theta\), jahan \(r = |z|\); \(\theta\) argument (simt ka angle) hai. Principal argument \(\arg z\) woh hai jo \((-\pi, \pi]\) mein ho.
Impedance: \(Z = R + iX\); \(R\) resistance hai aur \(X = X_{L} - X_{C}\) reactance.
Cryptography: parhne wale message (plaintext) ko key ki madad se khufia code (ciphertext) banana (encryption) aur wapas asal banana (decryption).

blocks.text: Key formulas (aham formulas)
Yahan \(a, b, c, d, k, x, y\) sab real numbers hain aur \(i^{2} = -1\) hai.
Complex numbers ka algebra

blocks.text: Ordered pairs mein: \((a, b)^{-1} = \left(\frac{a}{a^{2}+b^{2}}, \frac{-b}{a^{2}+b^{2}}\right)\), jab \((a, b) \ne (0, 0)\). Additive identity \((0, 0)\), multiplicative identity \((1, 0)\), aur \((a, b)\) ka additive inverse \((-a, -b)\) hai.
Conjugate aur modulus

blocks.text_alt: agar z barabar a plus i b to z bar barabar a minus i b
a plus i b ka modulus barabar square root of a square plus b square
z zarb z bar barabar a square plus b square barabar modulus z ka square
z ka real part barabar z plus z bar taqseem 2
z ka imaginary part barabar z minus z bar taqseem 2 i
1 taqseem z barabar z bar taqseem modulus z ka square, jab z zero na ho

blocks.text: Yahan \(|z| = \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}\) aur \(y \ne 0\). Factor \(\frac{iy}{|y|}\) ka matlab: \(y > 0\) ho to \(i\), \(y < 0\) ho to \(-i\). Misal: \(\sqrt{5+12i} = \pm(3+2i)\) aur \(\sqrt{8-6i} = \pm(3-i)\).
Roots of unity (ikaai ke roots)

omega barabar minus 1 plus root 3 i taqseem 2, omega square barabar minus 1 minus root 3 i taqseem 2
1 plus omega plus omega square barabar 0, aur omega cube barabar 1

blocks.text_alt: a cube ke teen cube roots a, a omega aur a omega square hain
unity ke chaar fourth roots 1, minus 1, i aur minus i hain
x cube plus y cube barabar x plus y, zarb x plus omega y, zarb x plus omega square y

blocks.text: Yani \(|z_{1}z_{2}| = |z_{1}||z_{2}|\), \(\arg(z_{1}z_{2}) = \arg z_{1} + \arg z_{2}\) aur \(\arg\frac{z_{1}}{z_{2}} = \arg z_{1} - \arg z_{2}\) (\(2\pi\) ke kisi multiple tak). Jama aur tafreeq (addition, subtraction) ka polar mein koi chhota rule nahin: \(z_{1} \pm z_{2} = r_{1}(\cos\theta_{1} + i\sin\theta_{1}) \pm r_{2}(\cos\theta_{2} + i\sin\theta_{2})\), is liye pehle dono ko \(x + iy\) form mein badlein.

blocks.text: Cryptography (Example 18, Exercise 1.5 Q17-Q19): har letter ek number \(z\) hai (A = 1, ..., Z = 26). Zarb wali key \(k\) ho to: encrypted \(= z \times k\), decrypted \(= \text{encrypted} \div k\) (yani \(k^{-1}\) se zarb). Jama wali key ho to: encrypted \(= z + k\), decrypted \(= \text{encrypted} - k\).
Fundamental rules (bunyadi qaide)
Formulas ke saath yeh qaide bhi zabani yaad hon. Har qaide ke saath maine chhoti si misal di hai taa ke aap foran check kar sakein.

items: \(i\) ki powers: \(i^{4n} = 1\), \(i^{4n+1} = i\), \(i^{4n+2} = -1\), \(i^{4n+3} = -i\). Power ko 4 se taqseem karein aur sirf remainder dekhein; misal \(i^{17} = i\). Aur \(\frac{1}{i} = -i\).
Equality: \(a + ib = c + id\) sirf tab jab \(a = c\) aur \(b = d\). Ek complex equation se do real equations milti hain.
\(C\) tamam field axioms poore karta hai lekin is mein order nahin: \(z_{1} > z_{2}\) ka koi matlab nahin (haan, moduli real hain, un ka muqabla ho sakta hai).

Conjugate ki properties: \(\overline{\overline{z}} = z\); \(\overline{z_{1} \pm z_{2}} = \overline{z_{1}} \pm \overline{z_{2}}\); \(\overline{z_{1}z_{2}} = \overline{z_{1}}\,\overline{z_{2}}\); \(\overline{z_{1}/z_{2}} = \overline{z_{1}}/\overline{z_{2}}\); \(\overline{z} = z\) sirf tab jab \(z\) real ho.
Square root ka sign rule: \(y > 0\) ho to root ke real aur imaginary parts ka sign ek jaisa; \(y < 0\) ho to ulta.

\(\omega\) ki baatein: kisi bhi complex cube root ko \(\omega\) keh sakte hain, doosra phir \(\omega^{2}\) hoga; \(\omega\) aur \(\omega^{2}\) ek doosre ke conjugate hain; \(\omega^{3} = 1\), is liye power ko 3 se taqseem karein (\(\omega^{28} = \omega\)); \(\omega + \omega^{2} = -1\), \(1 + \omega = -\omega^{2}\), \(1 + \omega^{2} = -\omega\); \(\omega\) equation \(x^{2} + x + 1 = 0\) ka root hai.
Fourth roots of unity: in ka jama \(0\) aur zarb \(-1\); \(1\) aur \(-1\) additive inverses; \(i\) aur \(-i\) conjugates.
Fundamental theorem of algebra: degree \(n \ge 1\) wali polynomial ke \(C\) mein theek \(n\) roots hote hain (dohraya hua root utni baar gina jata hai, misal \(z^{2} - 2iz - 1 = (z - i)^{2}\)).
Corollary (natija): \(P(z) = a(z - z_{1})(z - z_{2})\cdots(z - z_{n})\), jahan \(a\) leading coefficient aur \(z_{1}, \dots, z_{n}\) roots hain.
Factor theorem (Example 9 mein istemal hua): \(P(r) = 0\) ho to \(z - r\) factor hai; synthetic division se baqi factor nikal lein.
Rational root theorem: integer coefficients wali \(P(x)\) ka har rational root \(\frac{p}{q}\) (lowest terms mein) aisa hota hai ke \(p\), \(a_{0}\) ka factor aur \(q\), \(a_{n}\) ka factor ho.
Real coefficients hon to non-real roots hamesha conjugate joron mein aate hain (\(2 \pm i\), \(1 \pm i\), \(\pm 2i\)).

Completing the square: \(z^{2}\) ke coefficient se taqseem karein, constant ko right side le jayein, dono taraf (\(z\) ke coefficient ka aadha)\(^{2}\) jama karein, phir \(\pm\) ke saath square root lein.
Polar coordinates: \(r < 0\) ho to point \(|r|\) units \(\theta + \pi\) ki simt mein hota hai; \((-5, \frac{\pi}{4})\) aur \((5, \frac{5\pi}{4})\) ek hi point hain.

Principal argument: pehle \(x\) aur \(y\) ke signs se quadrant tay karein (neeche table). Axes par: \(\arg z = 0\) (positive real), \(\pi\) (negative real), \(\frac{\pi}{2}\) (positive imaginary), \(-\frac{\pi}{2}\) (negative imaginary); \(z = 0\) ka koi argument nahin.

blocks.caption: Principal argument \((-\pi, \pi]\) mein; \(\alpha = \tan^{-1}\left|\frac{y}{x}\right|\) chhota (acute) angle hai

blocks.text: Common mistakes (aam ghaltiyan)
Ab woh ghaltiyan dekhte hain jo main har saal paper check karte hue dekhta hoon. Har box mein ghalat tareeqa aur sahi tareeqa dono hain.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: \(i^{2} = -1\) mein sign ki ghalti. \((3 - i)(3 + i) = 9 - i^{2} = 9 + 1 = 10\), \(8\) nahin. Zarb mein \(i^{2}bd\) wala term real hai aur \(-bd\) ke barabar hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: Conjugate mein dono sign badal dena. \(\overline{3 + 4i} = 3 - 4i\), \(-3 - 4i\) nahin. Aur \(\operatorname{Im}(3 + 4i) = 4\) hai, \(4i\) nahin.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: Modulus ke formula mein \(i\) daal dena. \(|3 + 4i| = \sqrt{3^{2} + 4^{2}} = 5\), \(\sqrt{9 + (4i)^{2}}\) nahin.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: Square root: dono parts ke sign \(y\) ke sign ke mutabiq hon. \(\sqrt{8 - 6i} = \pm(3 - i)\), \(\pm(3 + i)\) nahin, kyun ke \(y = -6 < 0\). Hamesha dono roots (\(\pm\)) likhein.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: \(\sqrt{a}\sqrt{b} = \sqrt{ab}\) tab sahi nahin jab \(a\) aur \(b\) dono negative hon: \(\sqrt{-4}\sqrt{-9} = (2i)(3i) = -6\), \(\sqrt{36} = 6\) nahin. Pehle \(\sqrt{-a} = i\sqrt{a}\) likhein.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: \(-1\) ki fractional powers: pehle square root, phir power, jaise kitab karti hai: \((-1)^{-21/2} = (\sqrt{-1})^{-21} = i^{-21} = -i\). Agar pehle power \(-21\) lein to \(((-1)^{-21})^{1/2} = \sqrt{-1} = i\) aata hai, jo alag jawab hai. Aur \(\frac{1}{i} = -i\) hai, \(i\) nahin.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: Factorise karte hue leading coefficient bhool jana: \(2z^{2} - 22z + 65 = 2\left(z - \frac{11-3i}{2}\right)\left(z - \frac{11+3i}{2}\right)\); 2 ke baghair product polynomial ka sirf aadha hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: Sirf \(\tan^{-1}\) se ghalat quadrant. \(z = -1 - i\) ke liye \(\tan^{-1}\frac{-1}{-1} = \tan^{-1}1 = \frac{\pi}{4}\), lekin point Quadrant III mein hai, is liye \(\arg z = -\frac{3\pi}{4}\). Pehle point ka chhota sa sketch bana lein.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: \(\tan\theta = \frac{y}{x}\) mein \(x\) aur \(y\) ulat dena: \(4 + 3i\) ke liye \(\theta = \tan^{-1}\frac{3}{4} \approx 36.87^{\circ}\), \(53.13^{\circ}\) nahin.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: \(r < 0\) wala polar point \(\theta\) ki simt mein lagana. Woh ulti simt, yani \(\theta + \pi\) mein jata hai. Degrees aur radians ko mila na dein.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: \(\omega\) ki powers: power ko 3 se taqseem karein (2 ya 4 se nahin). Jama \(1 + \omega + \omega^{2} = 0\) aur zarb \(1 \cdot \omega \cdot \omega^{2} = 1\) ko gadmad na karein. Fourth roots of unity ka zarb \(-1\) hai, \(1\) nahin.

blocks.title: Aam ghalti
blocks.text: Polar form mein jama karte hue moduli jama kar dena. Chhote rules sirf zarb aur taqseem ke hain; \(z_{1} + z_{2}\) ke liye pehle dono ko \(x + iy\) form mein badlein.

Conjugate (1.1.1): kitab likhti hai ke \(5 - 4i\), \(5 - 4i\) ka conjugate hai; sahi yeh hai ke \(5 - 4i\) ka conjugate \(5 + 4i\) hai.
Example 9: \(z^{2} - 4z + 5 = 0\) ke roots \(z = 2 \pm i\) hain, \(2 \pm 2i\) nahin (kitab ki aakhri factorisation sahi hai).

Exercise 1.3 answer key: Q1(viii) mein leading factor 2 chahiye; Q4(ii) \(3 \pm i\sqrt{21}\), Q4(iii) \(3 \pm \frac{\sqrt{69}}{3}i\), Q4(vi) \(\frac{5 \pm i\sqrt{59}}{6}\); key mein 5, 6, 7 wale jawab asal mein Q6, Q7, Q8 ke hain.

Exercise 1.4: Q1(ii) \(-8\) hona chahiye (key usi ke cube roots deti hai); Q2(i) \((1 + \omega - \omega^{2})^{8} = 256\omega\) hai; Q5: \(-1\) ke complex cube roots \(\frac{1 \pm \sqrt{3}\,i}{2}\) hain, aur \((-1 + \sqrt{-3})^{4} + (-1 - \sqrt{-3})^{4} = -16\) hai, \(16\) nahin.

Exercise 1.5 answer key: bohat se jawab ghalat hain, misal Q2(i) \(5\operatorname{cis}36.87^{\circ}\), Q3(i) \(2 - 2\sqrt{3}\,i\), Q5(iv) \(-\frac{7}{11}\), Q12 line \(y = -x\), Q14 line \(x + y = \frac{1}{3}\) aur Q16 \(I = 2 + 14i\). Har jawab Exercise 1.5 ke page par check karein.

blocks.text: Short revision notes (mukhtasar notes)

items: Naya qaida sirf ek hai: \(i^{2} = -1\); baqi sab aam algebra hai, \(i\) ko ek letter ki tarah samjhein.
Real aur imaginary part parhne se pehle jawab ko hamesha \(a + ib\) form mein layein.
Taqseem ke liye denominator ke conjugate se zarb dein: \((c + id)(c - id) = c^{2} + d^{2}\) real hai.
\(z\overline{z} = |z|^{2}\) conjugate aur modulus ko jorta hai; isi se \(\frac{1}{z} = \frac{\overline{z}}{|z|^{2}}\) milta hai.
Ek complex equation = do real equations (real parts, imaginary parts).
Square roots hamesha jora \(\pm w\) hain; \(y\) ka sign \(w\) ke andar ke signs tay karta hai.
Degree \(n\) yani \(n\) roots aur \(n\) linear factors; leading coefficient aage zaroor rakhein.
Cubic ka pehla root dhoondne ke liye \(a_{0}\) ke factors (\(a_{n}\) ke factors par) \(\pm\) ke saath try karein.
\(\omega^{3} = 1\) aur \(1 + \omega + \omega^{2} = 0\) se \(\omega\) ke taqreeban saare sawal hal ho jate hain.
Polar form: zarb mein moduli zarb aur arguments jama; taqseem mein moduli taqseem aur arguments tafreeq.
Argument se pehle quadrant dhoondein; principal argument \((-\pi, \pi]\) mein hota hai.
AC circuits mein \(V = IZ\) Ohm ka qanoon hi hai, bas resistance ki jagah impedance \(Z = R + iX\).

blocks.text: Unit summary (unit ka khulasa)

Unit 1 mein humne real numbers ko barha kar complex numbers \(z = a + ib\) tak pohanchaya, jahan \(i = \sqrt{-1}\). Aap ne real aur imaginary parts pehchanna, conjugate likhna, complex numbers ko jama, tafreeq, zarb aur taqseem karna (ordered pairs mein bhi) seekha, aur unhein Argand diagram par points ki surat mein dikhaya, jahan modulus origin se faasla hai. Real aur imaginary parts barabar kar ke aap ne complex equations hal kin aur square roots nikale. Fundamental theorem of algebra ke mutabiq degree \(n\) ki har polynomial \(C\) mein \(n\) linear factors mein toot jati hai; yeh factors aap ne grouping, quadratic formula, rational root theorem aur completing the square se nikale.

Cube roots of unity \(1, \omega, \omega^{2}\) aur fourth roots \(1, -1, i, -i\) ki aasaan properties (\(\omega^{3} = 1\), \(1 + \omega + \omega^{2} = 0\)) lambi expressions ko chhota kar deti hain. Polar form \(z = r(\cos\theta + i\sin\theta)\) complex number ko faasle aur simt se batati hai; is form mein zarb aur taqseem bohat aasaan ho jati hai, aur \(|z|\) ya \(\arg z\) wali equations plane mein lines aur circles ban jati hain. Aakhir mein complex numbers \(V = IZ\) ke zariye AC circuits samjhate hain aur simple encryption mein bhi kaam aate hain. Shabash, ab exercises ke sawal dobara kar ke apni tayyari pakki karein!
